svg.title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory

cc:Work.dc:title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory
cc:Work.dc:description: Latest verified Scriptw versus V8, all 17 fresh Store/Realm workloads. Measured 2026-10-25 20:58 UTC; compiler 44e17ee4c73eeab6cc970804199109aa2aee51a9. Lower is better. Paired bars use a shared zero-based linear scale within each section: median elapsed milliseconds and median post-execution process RSS in MiB. RSS includes host/runtime, setup and retained warmup effects; it is not live JavaScript heap usage or a peak. Each runtime has 14 measured observations from two rounds of seven after ten warmups. Existing-Realm calls are separate. Source report SHA-256: e422513b5b0308cf7578010a488b7e14c5e0bfef7385dc08040dba8df84873bd. Archive SHA-256: cdc96a101b3926d1bbee36dd740e6eae103c428dfcdad69107d300fcd5117265. sort-reverse-128.js: V8 0.019 ms, Scriptw 2.408 ms; V8 RSS 52.8 MiB, Scriptw RSS 127.4 MiB. sort-reverse-512.js: V8 0.111 ms, Scriptw 9.675 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 137.4 MiB. sort-sorted-512.js: V8 0.104 ms, Scriptw 7.338 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 137.0 MiB. to-sorted-512.js: V8 0.107 ms, Scriptw 7.753 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 137.1 MiB. join-1024.js: V8 0.050 ms, Scriptw 8.768 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 137.1 MiB. join-4096.js: V8 0.702 ms, Scriptw 33.919 ms; V8 RSS 61.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 137.0 MiB. join-mixed-1024.js: V8 0.148 ms, Scriptw 9.284 ms; V8 RSS 60.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 137.1 MiB. numeric-loop-10000.js: V8 0.588 ms, Scriptw 1.307 ms; V8 RSS 59.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 118.0 MiB. numeric-loop-50000.js: V8 0.895 ms, Scriptw 4.427 ms; V8 RSS 61.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 116.6 MiB. folded-string-4096.js: V8 0.169 ms, Scriptw 1.840 ms; V8 RSS 59.3 MiB, Scriptw RSS 121.1 MiB. dynamic-string-4096.js: V8 0.709 ms, Scriptw 3.129 ms; V8 RSS 61.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 119.9 MiB. integer.js: V8 2.021 ms, Scriptw 4.811 ms; V8 RSS 60.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 119.7 MiB. objects.js: V8 0.053 ms, Scriptw 5.222 ms; V8 RSS 53.8 MiB, Scriptw RSS 133.3 MiB. retained-objects.js: V8 3.009 ms, Scriptw 439.820 ms; V8 RSS 71.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 149.6 MiB. join-empty-1024.js: V8 0.162 ms, Scriptw 2.606 ms; V8 RSS 58.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 124.1 MiB. join-singleton-1024.js: V8 0.180 ms, Scriptw 2.814 ms; V8 RSS 59.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 124.0 MiB. join-small-1024.js: V8 0.231 ms, Scriptw 3.715 ms; V8 RSS 60.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 123.8 MiB.
